description: This file defines the BudgetsProvider class, a state management provider in a Flutter application that handles loading, adding, updating, and removing budget data via a BudgetRepository. It provides a cache of budgets and exposes methods for managing them with change notifications.

classes.name: BudgetsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier-based provider that manages a list of budgets, with methods for loading, adding, updating, and removing budgets, and handling errors and loading state.

methods.name: BudgetsProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with a repository, defaulting to the singleton instance.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads budgets, optionally filtered by category and period, updating internal cache and error state.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new budget through the repository and updates the cache.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget through the repository and modifies the cache accordingly.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a budget by ID via the repository and updates the internal cache.
